en: Vintage sepia postcard with extensive handwritten Spanish text on the right and embossed lettering on the left. The right side contains printed Spanish headings related to an industrial exhibition and centenary celebration in Buenos Aires, along with a small red diamond logo containing the letters "AG". Below the writing is a black‑and‑white photograph showing a rural pampas landscape with cattle gathered at a waterhole and a few trees on the horizon. A printed caption under the image reads "Un Rodeo en la Provincia de Buenos Aires".
